preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The lengths of strings A and B must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B must consist only of lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any(s1 + s2 == s2[::-1] + s1[::-1] for s1 in substrings(A) for s2 in substrings(B)) else 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if there exists a non-empty substring s1 of A and a non-empty substring s2 of B such that s1 + s2 is a palindrome, otherwise output 'No'.
